# Pause

> Pause is an iPhone app that helps you use your phone on your terms by turning intentions into rules.

## The four rules
- Session: block chosen apps for a set amount of time, starting now.
- Schedule: block chosen apps automatically between set times on set days.
- Time Limit: allow a set number of minutes per day, then block the app.
- Open Limit: allow a set number of opens per day, with an optional length per open.
